contextThresholdSettingsIntro: These are global context-management options. After context usage reaches “start pruning”, NarraFork progressively prunes old tool context; when the pruned ratio reaches “max prune”, it forces a background compaction and summarizes older conversation history. If “start compacting” is at or below “start pruning”, progressive pruning is disabled and compaction triggers directly at the compacting threshold.
contextThresholdSettingsStandardDesc: Used for models with context windows ≤600k tokens.
contextThresholdSettingsLargeDesc: Used for models with context windows >600k tokens; large-context models can start pruning earlier or more conservatively.

emptyResponseError: {{provider}} returned an empty response. This usually means the API is misconfigured (base URL, model, or credentials).
emptyResponseErrorGeneric: The provider returned an empty response. This usually means the API is misconfigured (base URL, model, or credentials).
emptyResponseNoEvents: {{provider}} accepted the request but streamed no data at all. The upstream most likely dropped the response; if it keeps happening, check the base URL, model, and credentials.
emptyResponseUsageOnly: {{provider}} streamed only bookkeeping data (usage/queue) and no content. The request reached the model, so this is an upstream problem, not a local configuration error.
emptyResponseNamelessToolCall: {{provider}} announced a tool call without a tool name, so nothing could run. This is an upstream protocol fault.
emptyResponseStopWithoutContent: {{provider}} finished with "{{stopReason}}" but produced no content. The request reached the model, so this is an upstream problem, not a local configuration error.
reasoningOnlyExhausted: {{provider}} kept returning reasoning without an answer or tool call. This is a model-behaviour problem — try a different model or simplify the task.
bufferPreservedNotice: Queued messages have been preserved. They will be sent automatically after a successful retry.
modelUnavailableWaitingDesc: {{model}} has no available credentials right now. Waiting for it to recover — you can interrupt to stop waiting.

leakedToolRecoveredBody: Streaming capture missed a tool call, but it was recovered from the full response text and executed. Downloading the raw request/response data can help diagnose why streaming capture failed.
leakedToolUnrecoveredBody: Leaked tool-call markup (<invoke>) was detected in the response but could not be parsed into a tool call, so a tool may not have run. Download the raw data to investigate.
